serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Our orders are ready! Let’s dig in!
You: It’s pretty good, it’s exactly what I was looking for although I ate better ones.
You: Nothing beats handmade things made with love.
Bot: I didn’t know you were such a fan of sweets.
You: I think everyone likes to eat something sweet from time to time. 
You: How does your crepe taste?
Bot: It seems to be ok. Do you want a bite?
You: Sure, although I don’t think our flavors will mix well. 
You: It’s surprisingly good, but my tongue is tingling a bit since I was eating my sweet crepe just a second ago.
Bot: Let me taste yours!
You: Here you go.
Bot: Wow, it has a lot more sugar than I expected. No wonder the susceptible human brain gets addicted to it so easily.
You: I don’t think I would want to eat a crepe everyday like some junkie, my stomach would give out…
Bot: Right! And your body would get grotesquely bloated! 
You: That’s no way to call a chubby person…
